question: Do five CPU-answerable draft designs from test matrix v3, and the open JTT tie-noise issue, meet their stated rules on fresh seeds?

registration.written: 2026-11-10, after one calibration seed per study and before any confirmation seed
registration.note: The pre-registration was not in a pushed commit before the runs. Frozen-file hashes below were recorded before the confirmation runs and re-checked at analysis time.

statistics: Paired differences over seeds; two-sided 95% t interval; exact sign-flip permutation p (harness.stats.paired_test). Lower bound = lower end of that interval. No exclusions.

jtt-upweighting-controls-v1.rule: JTT minus uniform second-stage training: decorrelated-level success lower bound >= +0.05 and IID success difference lower bound >= -0.05, random-tie condition.

jtt-error-set-composition-v1.rule: Decorrelated-level steps enriched in the first-stage error set by >= 10 points (lower bound) and JTT minus random upweighting lower bound >= +0.05. Open-issue components: tied steps over-represented in the error set; (JTT - uniform, deterministic ties) - (JTT - uniform, random ties) lower bound > 0.

omp-fixed-dictionary-v1.rule: Support F1 of OMP minus an amortized TopK encoder on the frozen planted dictionary: lower bound >= +0.05 at d = 10 (n = 64), equal code budget.

kmeans-amplitude-shift-v1.rule: MMCS loss under amplitude shift, Euclidean minus spherical k-means: lower bound >= 0.02; unshifted spherical minus Euclidean lower bound >= -0.01.

matryoshka-random-nesting-v1.rule: Child MMCS, nested minus random nesting: lower bound >= +0.02; parent MMCS difference lower bound >= -0.01.

limits: Toy scale, default hyperparameters, one agent, no second runner. Predictions were written after one calibration seed. No catalogue verdict or direction signal changes.
spend: None. CPU only, no model calls.
